description: An agent-oriented MCP server for Capacities API 2.0 with precise block-level CRUD, Markdown and structured content authoring, file uploads, API key pooling, concurrency-safe writes, and Daily Notes support.

CAPACITIES_API_TOKEN.description: One Capacities API 2.0 token, or multiple tokens separated by commas or semicolons. All tokens must belong to the same Capacities space and have the same permissions.

CAPACITIES_MCP_READBACK.description: Controls mutation readback verification. Set to false to disable ordinary mutation readback.
